title: How often should my child visit for occupational therapy sessions?
metaTitle: Occupational Therapy Frequency - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand how the frequency of occupational therapy sessions are determined at Pinnacle Blooms Network, designed uniquely for your child's optimal progress.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, each child's therapy schedule is a bespoke plan crafted keeping their unique needs, progress rate, and overall therapy goals in mind. The frequency can vary widely. Some children benefit more from intensive therapy, with multiple sessions a week, while others may see optimal results with just one session a week. Most importantly, we tailor the schedule to give maximum comfort and benefit to your child, ensuring successful strides in their progress at their own pace.
